cases.title: Override flags apply for one run and are saved in state.json
steps: Build the engine and make a fresh temp repo as TESTING.md 'How to see the app' describes ($CLI, $FIX, $REPO)
cd $REPO && node $CLI $FIX/diamond --spec $FIX/spec.md --provider fake --fix-passes 0 --attempts 1 --validate-at end --idle-timeout 0.5; echo EXIT=$?
cat $REPO/.graph-execution/<run-id>/state.json; ls $REPO/graph-execution.config.json
node $CLI --help
cases.expected: EXIT=0; state.json has "overrides": {"fixPasses":0,"attempts":1,"validateAt":"end","idleTimeoutMinutes":0.5} (key order may differ); no graph-execution.config.json exists; --help lists --attempts, --fix-passes, --validation-rounds, --validate-at, --validate-parallel, --no-validate-parallel and --idle-timeout

cases.title: --resume refuses the flags and keeps the saved values
steps: In a fresh $REPO: echo '{"task:1":{"attempts":[{"commit":false,"write":{}},{"commit":false,"write":{}},{"commit":false,"write":{}}]}}' > $REPO/.git/fake.json
GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_SCRIPT=$REPO/.git/fake.json node $CLI $FIX/diamond --spec $FIX/spec.md --provider fake --attempts 1; echo EXIT=$?
Check state.json: tasks["1"].attempts and overrides
node $CLI --resume --attempts 2; echo EXIT=$?
node $CLI --resume; echo EXIT=$?  (no fake script: task 1 now succeeds)
cat state.json again
cases.expected: First run EXIT=2 after one attempt (tasks["1"].attempts is 1, overrides {attempts:1}); --resume --attempts 2 prints 'cannot change --attempts on --resume: the run keeps the options it started with' and EXIT=2; the plain --resume ends EXIT=0 and state.json still has overrides {attempts:1}

cases.title: Bad flag values are usage errors
steps: In a fresh $REPO: node $CLI $FIX/diamond --spec $FIX/spec.md --provider fake --validate-at sometimes; echo EXIT=$?
node $CLI $FIX/diamond --spec $FIX/spec.md --provider fake --fix-passes -1; echo EXIT=$?
ls $REPO/.graph-execution
cases.expected: Both exit 2 with an error naming the option (--validate-at: 'must be task or end'); no .graph-execution folder was created

cases.title: Start API passes the options and the run pauses for human review
steps: Start graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages first), log in, connect GitHub (token gh-good) and clone octo/hello
In $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello copy packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/diamond and __fixtures__/spec.md in and commit them (git add . && git commit -m fixture)

curl -s -b $GM_DIR/c -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"tasksDir":"diamond","spec":"spec.md","provider":"fake","options":{"humanReview":true,"merge":false,"fixPasses":2}}' http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/runs/github~octo~hello
Poll curl -s -b $GM_DIR/c http://127.0.0.1:7420/runs/github~octo~hello/<runId>/view/state until review.waiting is true (up to 60 s)
cat $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello/.graph-execution/<runId>/state.json
agent-browser open http://127.0.0.1:7420/runs/github~octo~hello/<runId> and screenshot
cases.expected: 201 {runId, viewUrl}; the view state reaches review.waiting true; state.json has humanReview true, overrides {fixPasses:2} and no targetBranch (--no-merge); the run detail page shows 'Waiting for your review' in the embedded run page

cases.title: Extra arguments: reserved flags are refused, quoting is kept
steps: Continue with the server from P4 (or start it as there)
POST /api/runs/github~octo~hello with options.extraArgs "--web", then "--spec x.md", then "--provider claude"
POST with options.extraArgs "--model 'a b'" and provider fake
cat the new run's state.json
cases.expected: The three reserved cases answer 400 with error 'extra arguments: --web is set by graph-manager' (resp. --spec, --provider) and start no run; the quoted case answers 201 and state.json has "model": "a b"

cases.title: Choices are remembered per workspace and prefill the drawer
steps: After P4: curl -s -b $GM_DIR/c http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/run-defaults
grep runDefaults $GM_DIR/data/graph-manager.json
agent-browser open http://127.0.0.1:7420/runs, press s, choose workspace octo/hello, wait 1 s, snapshot -i and screenshot
cases.expected: run-defaults returns {provider:"fake", tasksDir:"diamond", spec:"spec.md", options:{humanReview:true, merge:false, fixPasses:2}} (the last successful start); graph-manager.json holds it under runDefaults; the drawer shows provider fake (test), tasks diamond, spec spec.md, Human review On, Merge Off, More options open with Fix passes 2, and the preview lists --no-merge, --human-review and --fix-passes 2

cases.title: Start run drawer: every option, inline errors and the preview
steps: Start graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages first), log in, connect GitHub (token gh-good) and clone octo/hello
agent-browser set viewport 1440 900; open /runs and press s
Check that More options is collapsed on a workspace with no saved choices; open it
Type 0 in Concurrency; snapshot -i

Set Concurrency 5, Model opus, Attempts 1, Fix passes 0, Validation rounds 2, Validate 'At the end', Parallel validation Off, Idle timeout 0.5, Extra arguments '--foo bar'; read the 'Will run' preview
Screenshot in light and dark (Settings → Appearance), then set viewport 800 900 and eval 'document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth'
cases.expected: With Concurrency 0 the field shows 'Whole number from 1 to 64' and Start run is disabled; with valid values Start is enabled and the preview prints one flag per line in this order: graph-execution .agents/tasks, --spec …, --provider …, --model opus, --concurrency 5, --attempts 1, --fix-passes 0, --validation-rounds 2, --validate-at end, --no-validate-parallel, --idle-timeout 0.5, --foo bar, --web; the screenshots match the drawer style of docs/design/graph-manager/05-*.png; the eval prints 0

cases.title: Start from the drawer with Human review on
steps: Start graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages first), log in, connect GitHub (token gh-good) and clone octo/hello
In $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello copy packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/diamond and __fixtures__/spec.md in and commit them (git add . && git commit -m fixture)
In the drawer: workspace octo/hello, tasks diamond, spec spec.md, provider fake (test), Human review On; press Ctrl+Enter
Click Open on the toast; wait up to 60 s; screenshot
cases.expected: The toast 'Started run gm-…' appears; the run detail page's embedded run page shows 'Waiting for your review'; curl …/view/state shows review.waiting true
